findings.obligation: SSOT/dependency direction: one owner of the default outlier rule; design says the definition is registered in Program
findings.observation: Both services declare 'ICycleTimeOutlierDefinition? outlierDefinition = null' and 'outlierDefinition ?? new UpperNaturalProcessLimitOutlierDefinition()', while Program.cs registers 'AddSingleton<ICycleTimeOutlierDefinition, UpperNaturalProcessLimitOutlierDefinition>()'. The default rule has two owners; a DI-registered replacement wins, but any call site that omits it silently gets UNPL. Reason given: 15 oracle-owned call sites construct the services. Severity Medium, advisory.
findings.remediation: Accept as a recorded trade-off in the design, or make the parameter required and have the oracle owner pass the definition at the call sites.

findings.obligation: Impact usage-docs: decisions 1 to 3 superseded by the new ADR (Migrated)
findings.observation: ADR-282 title still reads 'An outlier is a value above a fixed multiple of the median, computed in the frontend, per chart' and Status is 'Accepted (decided and shipped 2026-11-14).' with no superseded note, though adr-270 line 505 says the new rule 'Supersedes the 5 x median rule of ADR-282'. Not in the slice diff. Severity Low.
findings.remediation: Mark decisions 1-3 of ADR-282 superseded and point to the new decision, in S2 or at finalize.

findings.observation: A cast stands in for the guarantee the enabled flag gives that fetcher is defined; a module-level mutable lastFetcherId plus WeakMap supplies fetcher identity. Works and is covered; the cast bypasses the checker. Severity Low.
findings.remediation: Replace the cast with a guard that rejects when the fetcher is absent, or key on owner and range alone and drop the identity counter.
